measurement.gradient_zeroing: excluded; persistent FP32 gradient is zeroed before each sample
measurement.sample_summary: three samples; median and min/max range reported; spread is max-min, not run-to-run uncertainty
measurement.timed_work: complete embedding forward+backward and accumulated FP32 gradient; no optimizer update

environment.topology: single node, eight H100 80GB GPUs, one eight-rank NCCL dense GFSDP mesh

timer_semantics.integrated: CUDA event span and synchronized wall for complete F+B; the communication stream joins completion events before endpoint; host call includes internal count reads and waits; endpoint synchronization is separate.
timer_semantics.phases: F and B separately with a synchronization boundary between them; diagnostic only and must not be summed to claim integrated latency.
timer_semantics.stages: StageObserver CUDA-event spans on the actual stage stream plus host context-call spans, without per-stage barriers. They include submission gaps/waits and are not kernel-only durations.
timer_semantics.trace_scopes: MCP separately reports non-NCCL compute kernels, NCCL, copies, memsets, interval union/span and host runtime waits. Sums may overlap; profiled rank-arrival stalls are not timing magnitude.
